tagline: A well-established Asian side residential and business district — tree-lined streets, good schools, corporate headquarters, and a quiet suburban comfort close to Ataşehir's commercial core.

items.name: İçerenköy Semt Kafeleri
items.description: A solid selection of neighbourhood cafés around the main streets — frequented by professionals working in the nearby Ataşehir business district.

items.name: İçerenköy Restoranları
items.description: A mix of neighbourhood lokantas and mid-range restaurants catering to the district's working and residential population.

items.name: İçerenköy Sahası ve Parkları
items.description: Several small parks and green spaces in the residential streets — good for a morning walk before commuting.

items.name: Palladium AVM
items.description: A modern shopping centre in the İçerenköy area with international brands, cinema, and dining options.

tips: İçerenköy is well-served by bus routes connecting to Kadıköy, Ataşehir, and the metro network.
A popular choice for professionals working in the Ataşehir finance and business corridor.
More residential and quieter than Ataşehir itself — better for families.
The nearby E5 highway gives good car access across the Asian side.
